verify.personBody: 梁植华，2012 年获南方卫理公会大学物理学博士学位，2003 年获清华大学物理学学士学位。2006 至 2012 年参加 CERN ATLAS 合作组，主攻 H→WW 衰变道的统计分析（2012 年发现希格斯玻色子的核心探测通道之一），并合作开发了次领头阶（NLO）QCD 计算软件 MEKS。2013 至 2016 年在休斯敦从事医学物理研发，2019 至 2023 年在比利时安特卫普大学 VisionLab 从事医学成像深度学习研究。2024 年 2 月至 2026 年 2 月任意大利国家核物理研究院（INFN）卡利亚里分部研究员，参与 CERN LHCb 实验物理分析。

next.h2: 本页内容将于何时更新，取决于以下关键节点。
items: 当前阶段
推进新一轮专题论文投稿、可预注册预测梳理及独立复现材料整理。研究资助将定向用于作者专职科研时间、计算资源、开放获取出版与独立专业评审。
2026-11-19 论文与专著状态

截至 2026-11-19：投往 Journal of Geometry and Physics 的稿件（JGP13432）仍在审稿中；条件性 Einstein–Yang–Mills 论文已完成修订，正准备改投其他期刊（已不再在 Classical and Quantum Gravity 审稿）。v3.0 专著在作者工作仓库持续编写中，目前尚无公开 v3.0 PDF；1003 页的 v2.0 公开审阅版保持原样冻结且未投稿期刊。
江门中微子实验（JUNO）已于 2025 年 8 月正式开始取数，并于 11 月公布首批物理结果。质量顺序的最终裁决尚需数年数据积累；若实验最终确立倒序，本框架的正常序主张及所有依赖它的物理结论必须立即撤回或修订。
预计 2028 年
Hyper-Kamiokande 最新官方概览以 2028 年启动实验为目标，将共同检验 CP 相位符号与质子是否衰变（具体日程视建设进度调整）。
DUNE 目前以 2029 年投入运行首台远端探测器为目标，率先开展天然中微子观测；加速器中微子束流目标为 2031 年，CP 符号与 θ₂₃ 卦限的核心实验检验依赖于随后的加速器束流取数。
BabyIAXO 轴子望远镜当前计划约 2029 年安装磁体、2030 年以后调试并启动轴子运行。一旦探测到符合预期的 QCD 轴子信号，即表明自然界处于本框架选定真空分支之外。
下一冻结日待定
专著下一公开冻结版本的时间尚未排定；在此之前，任何确证错漏只追加记录于公开勘误，已冻结 PDF 文件保持不变。

verify.buildNote: Every physical quantity printed on this page comes from one file, ledger.json: computed values, measured values, pulls, digit counts, the four Lean bucket totals. The build fills them in, recomputes what it can, and checks that the page prints those values; if anything disagrees, nothing is published. What the build cannot do is compare that file against the manuscript. The ledger is transcribed by hand, and that transcription is the step most worth checking. The file is served at /ledger.json.
targets: The step into the Standard Model

Whether the seven anonymous rows really are the seven kinds of field in one generation, and whether the three that the arithmetic counts really become three generations of particles in spacetime. Both 9/40 and the muon–electron mass ratio rest on those two steps. (Review target 8)
The second term in the Λ reading
Λ is read as two terms. Is the channel that supplies the second one forced by the reading rules, or is it chosen? (Review target B)
The lock on the sign of the CP phase
The manuscript argues that every layer of the framework is blind to the two faces of CP. Do those arguments close every route by which the sign could be fixed? (Review target C)
How cells are glued together
There is one ambiguity in the rules for gluing cells together. Does it change any number that comes out later? (Review target 5)
Any row one tier too strong
Closed, conditional, bound · test — and the diagnostic rows. Does any row wear a label one tier above what it earned? (Review target 6)

verify.personBody: Zhihua Liang holds a PhD in Physics from Southern Methodist University (2012) and a BSc in Physics from Tsinghua University (2003). From 2006 to 2012 he worked in the ATLAS collaboration on the statistical analysis of the H→WW channel, one of the analyses behind the 2012 Higgs discovery, and co-developed the NLO QCD program MEKS. He worked in medical physics in Houston from 2013 to 2016, and on deep learning for imaging at the University of Antwerp’s VisionLab from 2019 to 2023. From February 2024 to February 2026 he was a Researcher at INFN Sezione di Cagliari, working on the CERN LHCb experiment.

next.h2: The dates when this page will have to change.
items: Now

Move the next papers, preregistration-ready predictions and independent reproduction packages to publication. Support funds Founder research time, computation, open publication and professional review.
2026-11-19 paper and monograph status

As of 2026-11-19, the manuscript at the Journal of Geometry and Physics (JGP13432) remains under review; the conditional Einstein–Yang–Mills paper has completed revision and is being prepared for submission to a new target journal (no longer under review at Classical and Quantum Gravity). Work on v3.0 continues in the author’s working repository with no public v3.0 PDF yet; the 1003-page v2.0 public-review monograph remains frozen and unsubmitted.
From August 2025

JUNO began taking data in August 2025 and released its first physics results in November. A mass-ordering verdict still needs years of data; a confirmed inverted ordering would require withdrawing or revising the normal-ordering claim and the physical conclusions that depend on it.
Target: 2028
Hyper-Kamiokande’s latest official overview aims to begin experimentation in 2028. It has a hand in two verdicts here: the sign of the CP phase and whether the proton decays. Schedules can move.

DUNE currently targets operation of its first far detector in 2029, when natural-neutrino science can begin. Its accelerator neutrino beam is targeted for 2031; the central CP-sign and θ₂₃ programme depends on the beam exposure that follows.
2029–2030+ · schedule-dependent
BabyIAXO’s current plan puts magnet installation around 2029, followed by commissioning and axion runs from 2030 onward. A QCD-axion signal would put the world outside this cell’s selected branch.
Date not set
The next freeze of the manuscript, with no date set. Until then, corrections are appended to the errata and the PDF does not move.

Science, funding and any future token question are kept strictly apart. Attention, donations, grants and press coverage settle nothing scientific.
